name: Ornith 1.5 35B-A3B Q4_K_M on one Intel Arc Pro B70

library.summary: 35B-class Qwen-derived MoE (256 experts / 8 active, arch qwen35moe) reaching a directly measured 126.2 tok/s current-patch mean on one card with the lab's validated expert-reduction, recurrent, state-materialization, alpha-gate, routed gate/up, residual/RMSNorm, GDN normalization/gate, and in-place GDN state I/O patches.

featured_metric.label: decode (3B active parameters)
featured_metric.scope: Mean of two fresh-server suite medians (126.362 and 125.997 tok/s), up-to-512-token responses, target-only, cache-zero; the current ten-feature patch's in-place GDN state increment was +6.80% against its matched controls. This value is directly measured, not extrapolated from the prior operating point.

contributors.name: neural.download lab
contributors.contribution: Intake verification, bring-up, baselines, depth sweeps, ordered MoE add-reduction, recurrent convolution-SiLU, residual-RMSNorm, recurrent concat/state, direct gather/state, recurrent alpha-gate, routed-expert gate/up, MoE shared-branch residual/RMSNorm, GDN RMSNorm/SiLU-gate, and in-place GDN state I/O patches, operating point, canary battery, and package.
contributors.validated_effect: +4.85% matched fresh-server decode from ordered expert reduction, +2.10% incremental from recurrent convolution-SiLU, +1.37% incremental from residual-RMSNorm, +2.74% incremental from recurrent concat/state, +1.12% incremental from direct recurrent gather, +2.04% incremental from recurrent alpha-gate, +2.33% incremental from routed gate/up, +1.41% incremental from MoE shared-branch residual/RMSNorm, +0.78% incremental from GDN RMSNorm/SiLU-gate, then +6.80% incremental from in-place GDN state I/O (118.148 to 126.179 tok/s in its matched current-library suite).

performance_profiles.label: Current-stack raw decode over existing context depth
performance_profiles.scope: llama-bench raw engine rates using the exact current ten-feature patch, graph off, pp2048/tg128, flash attention on, F16 KV, and 5 repetitions at every displayed depth. No missing depth is interpolated.

performance_profiles.label: Current-stack raw pp2048 over existing context depth
performance_profiles.scope: llama-bench raw engine rates using the exact current ten-feature patch, graph off, pp2048/tg128, flash attention on, F16 KV, and 5 repetitions at every displayed depth. No missing depth is interpolated.

known_limitations: MoE rate reflects ~3B active parameters; not comparable to dense 35B expectations.
Canary battery is objective self-consistency only; no cross-model oracle.
Stock two-card layer split measured 102.01/102.20 tok/s versus 104.84/104.81 on one card (-2.6%): use one card for single-stream decode.

Fresh stock servers matched 0/12 complete realistic-suite hashes across processes on this runtime. A realistic same-process repeat also produced four hashes across eight requests; use same-frozen-binary door-off/on exactness and activation counts for patch validation, while the short exact-answer 8x canary remains a narrower check.

Stage the GGUF on local or sufficiently fast direct-attached storage; optimized first-token setup rereads roughly 20.0 GB of expert tensors, making a 100 Mb/s NFS mmap unsuitable for cold benchmarking.

runtime.build: cmake -G Ninja -B build-sycl-aot-bmg-g31 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=icpx -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=icx -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON -DGGML_NATIVE=ON -DGGML_SYCL=ON -DGGML_SYCL_F16=ON -DGGML_SYCL_GRAPH=ON -DGGML_SYCL_DNN=ON -DGGML_SYCL_HOST_MEM_FALLBACK=ON -DGGML_SYCL_DEVICE_ARCH=bmg_g31 -DGGML_SYCL_MAX_PARALLEL_LINK_JOBS=8 -DLLAMA_CURL=OFF && cmake --build build-sycl-aot-bmg-g31 --target llama-server llama-bench -j2

project_patches.reason: The validated one-card serving stack depends on the lab's strict ordered eight-expert FP32 reduction, Ornith-shape recurrent convolution-SiLU fusion, graph-visible residual-RMSNorm fusion, Qwen-derived recurrent concat/state fusion, direct gathered-state materialization, recurrent alpha-gate fusion, tuned routed-expert gate/up/SWIGLU fusion, MoE shared-branch residual/RMSNorm extension, exact GDN RMSNorm/SiLU-gate fusion, and in-place GDN persistent-state I/O.

commands.preflight: python3 scripts/verify-neural-download-model.py repro/ornith-15-35b-a3b-q4km-b70/model-manifest.json "$MODEL_DIR" && echo 'd8c95e4d0cbe0be91c0890f4e5d3c6b4f2bfb22b5daedd12a560910f954c915e  patches/ornith-15-35b-a3b-q4km-b70/llama-cpp-ornith15-ten-feature-stack-gdn-state-io-20260823.patch' | sha256sum -c - && source /opt/intel/oneapi/setvars.sh --force && export ONEAPI_DEVICE_SELECTOR=level_zero:0
